notes: Regex compiled once at YAML load and nil-filter skip were already in place (options 1+2, preserved). Measured on a pre-PR-34b base.

lever: heap-based Kahn topo-sort in Finalize

notes: Refined to clear only live/dirty prefixes in 396d955/4b04e1d/dbc9706.

lever: clear only live/dirty prefixes of pooled scratch
mechanism: scrub() clears only s[:len] for ModuleData reuse; pooled emit scratches record their high-water length (retainMaxLen) so the next reset clears just the dirty prefix instead of clear(s[:cap]) on every module.
notes: Refines 9f626bb full-capacity scrubbing (needed so stale pointers are not retained by the GC).

mechanism: Removed SetGCPercent(-1) for graph-only (-j0) runs and GOGC=400 for executor runs when GOGC was unset; Go's default policy applies.

mechanism: Sources are collapsed into equivalence classes by the pointer identity of their activeSourceKeyed sysincl record set (FNV over record addresses), so sources whose source-keyed filters accept the same records share every cached subgraph while differing classes stay separate.

lever: xxh3-128 instead of SHA-1 for node UID
mechanism: UID is an internal content-stable identity (normalizer recomputes uids), so a non-cryptographic SIMD hash suffices; a 16-byte digest base64url-encodes to the same 22 chars.
effect: SHA-1 (SHA-NI ~2 GB/s) was 19.6% of gen flat / 0.70s with ~1.4 GB hashed across the run; ~15x faster hashing; gen wall 2.69s -> 2.11s (-22%).
notes: stats_uid keeps md5 (mirrors upstream preimage, small string). xxh3 still in go.mod at HEAD.

site: fs.go osFS recordContentHash / ContentHash; uid.go writeVFSSlice
mechanism: xxh3(content) is recorded on every Read/ReadInto (files already read for scanning cost no extra read) into a plain growing []uint64 indexed by STR (slot 0 = unrecorded, xxh3 never 0); inputs never scanned are read lazily with one reused buffer. Single gen goroutine, no locks.
notes: Purpose is cache invalidation (content in uids). 90b4ad7 extends it to the -G/BufferedEmitter path and returns 0 for directories. Its re-intern hot spot was fixed in 825d2ce; the separate reuse buffer folded into Read in 05704fe.

lever: Morton (Z-order) key interleave via BMI2 PDEP
mechanism: Bit-interleaves two 32-bit dense ids into a uint64 so identity-hashed tables see well-mixed low bits; PDEP asm on amd64 with a portable magic-bit-spread fallback.
effect: asm 0.81ns/op vs generic 2.0ns/op; morton itself ~0.5ms per sg5 run
notes: Fuzz test checks asm == generic and that the encoding is bijective.

lever: intern table keyed by xxh3-128 hi with lo verify; drop hashes[]
site: vfs.go internTable: map[uint64]STR + los[] + exact string overflow map
mechanism: The string-keyed map is replaced by a uint64 map on the hi half of xxh3-128; a parallel los[] verifies hits by a uint64 compare and hi collisions route to an exact string-keyed overflow map. los[] doubles as the per-path UID hash, removing the separate xxh3-64 hashes[] and the miss-path double hash; map key shrinks 16B->8B.
effect: CPU-neutral (aeshash+strcompare traded for xxh3.Hash128 + uint64 map key hashing); does not reduce the ~12% map CPU - the lever there is the 2.4M lookup count; sg5 gen 3.1s
notes: Replaces the pre-slice hashes[] (xxh3-64 per string). Identity stays exact (no 128-bit false merge).

lever: splitMix64 finalizer of a<<32|b instead of Morton interleave for id-pair keys of identity-hashed IntMap/IntValueMap
mechanism: Morton is a bijection but not a hash: over dense sequential id spaces the interleaved low bits collide, so identity indexing (key & mask) built huge linear-probe clusters. splitmix64 is also a 64-bit bijection (exact, no verify) but scatters uniformly.
effect: Measured on sg5: sourceUnderCache/searchTierFlat ran 364 probes per Get (231M probes total); bySplit 20. ... brings both to ~1.66 probes. Effect (10x sg5 CPU profile): IntMap[uint32].Get 1380ms -> 550ms (9.0% -> 3.9%), total samples 15300ms -> 14180ms (-7.3% wall).
notes: Drops the BMI2 PDEP asm (morton_amd64.s) and generic/noasm split. internTable (xxh3-keyed, ~1.76 probes) unaffected. Undoes the Morton keying lever from an earlier slice.

lever: hash the scan context via interned los chained through mix64, not FNV over path bytes
site: hashScanContext (scanner); mix64 factored out of splitMix64
mechanism: Each addincl/search-path element contributes its interned string's xxh3 lo (already stored per STR) chained through the splitmix64 finalizer, with length prefixes keeping slice boundaries unambiguous; no byte-per-byte re-walk of every path on every NewScanCtx.
effect: 10x sg5: hashScanContext 580 ms -> below the profile drop threshold (<60 ms); warm gen user 0.77 -> 0.70-0.75 s.
notes: PERF.md item 4. Hash keys only in-memory config maps, so in-run id stability suffices. Later 4311fb3 seals the hash once per ScanContext construction, removing the per-walk mix.

lever: sum+square+xor multiset bucketHash, 2-wide unsafe
mechanism: Replace per-element Σ mix64(v) with three cheap order-independent invariants Σv, Σv², ⊕v folded once at the end, unrolled 2-wide with independent accumulators and unsafe pointer walk.
effect: Clean-field microbench (dev perf buckethash): 2.03x faster per element than mix64. Real build (yabs bs_static): storeBuckets 6.21s -> 5.14s (-1.07s)
notes: 38e7c2f reverted to keep production on Σ mix64(v) ('to pick up later'); re-landed as the injective pair hash 023b362. The message's 1118dcd is the pre-rewrite id of edfc810.

lever: injective 64+64 pair hash with overflow table
mechanism: Bucket folded into three 32-bit invariants (sum, xor, sum of squares) encoded into two 64-bit keys (bijective mix64): primary table keyed on h1 verifies h2, mismatches go to an overflow table keyed by h2, a full pair collision throws. No per-element mix64.
effect: 1.93x hash throughput clean-field, bucketHash cum 0.96s -> 0.59s, storeBuckets cum 4.05s -> 3.75s on bs_static
notes: Telemetry: 'bs_static: 49 buckets in overflow — real h1 collisions the old single-key scheme could not even observe'. Superseded by per-element mix64 sum/xor with SIMD (9ca51ac).

lever: bucketHash finalizer/moment hardening
mechanism: Bucket length mixed into both finalizer words (mix64(len+1)); a third moment Σx³ added to bucketHash and to the uid multiset fold (extra VPMULLD / VPMULUDQ); finalizer lane packing kept at rank 4 with no same-degree xor pairs so the (h1,h2) pair is injective in all four moments at fixed length.
notes: Correctness-driven (collision structure). Superseded by 9ca51ac for buckets; uid fold keeps its own accumulators.

lever: nonlinear invariant as primary key
mechanism: Primary key folds (sq, sum^xor) — all three invariants including the nonlinear one; linear (sum, xor) key backs the overflow table.
effect: bs_static drops from 49 overflow buckets to zero; the 1.3M-set collision stress shows zero h1 collisions
notes: Superseded by 9ca51ac.

lever: AVX2 bucketHash accumulation
mechanism: sum/xor/x*x accumulators map onto vpaddd/vpxor/vpmulld 8 lanes per iteration behind a CPUID+XGETBV gate with scalar tail; bit-identical results.
effect: bs_static, merged 6-run pprof: bucketHash cum 0.53s -> 0.21s, storeBuckets cum 3.67s -> 3.13s; wall min of 10: 4.44s -> 4.39s. Microbench: AVX2 ahead already at one vector (6.2ns vs 8.4ns; 4.9x at len 64)
notes: Threshold len>=8. Superseded by AVX2/AVX512 per-element mix64 kernels (9ca51ac).

lever: AVX2 64-bit uid accumulator
mechanism: VPADDQ/VPXOR plus low64(e*e) synthesized as lo*lo + (lo*hi)<<33 via VPMULUDQ; scalar tail and !amd64 fallback, matched-against-scalar tests; d3235d9 adds low64(e^3).

lever: per-element mix64 sum/xor bucket hash with AVX2/AVX512
mechanism: Bucket hash becomes (Σ mix64(v) + mix64(len+1), ⊕ mix64(v) ^ mix64(len+1)), computed by AVX2 (4-wide) or AVX512 (8-wide) mix64 block kernels for len >= 16 with 2-wide unrolled scalar tails; dispatch inlined.
notes: Motive: collision resistance — test with equal count/sum/xor/square/cube sets ({512,672,832,992} vs {544,608,896,960}). Replaces the moment-based scheme (023b362/096dabb).

lever: scanner-local interner: string→uint32, VFS = relID | bit31 root; numeric hot cache keys

effect: CPU samples 6.6s->5.66s (-14%), alloc 1964MB->1918MB; gen 6.57s.

lever: STR-keyed FS directory cache (dirs map[STR]map[STR]bool)
mechanism: Re-key the directory cache and children by interned ids so the dominant first-component probe is integer-keyed.
effect: sg5 wall flat (3.51s); intern table +51400 strings (+35%: 148319 -> 199719), retaining ~3.7MB.
notes: Reverted by 54c601d (pre-rebase 22087d9). Lesson stated: Go SwissMaps make faststr ~= fast32 apart from string hashing (both pay ctrlGroup.matchH2, ~3.7%); the real lever is probe COUNT (3.6M matchH2), which needs fewer lookups, not cheaper keys; eager interning of every basename pollutes the table.

lever: Pack VFS root into the low bit of the id
site: vfs.go (v = internId<<1 | root); vfsBound(); codegen_registry byStr re-keyed by strID
mechanism: Root() becomes a register bit test instead of reading internTable.strs[id][2]; String()/Rel() stay zero-alloc reads at strs[v>>1]. Low (not high) bit keeps ids dense in [0, 2*internBound) so idSet/Tarjan scratch arrays can index them directly.
effect: Root() was 2.6% of gen flat (0.10s -> ~0); gen wall ~3.02s -> 2.86s.
notes: Breaks VFS==STR identity; byStr keyed by STR(OutputPath) aliased other rel-STRs and spuriously resolved system headers as generated, fixed by keying on strID().

lever: executor never interns (keeps the intern table single-writer)
site: make.go restoreInto (mountVFS removed; mountString resolves $(B)/ meta paths from the string)
mechanism: restoreInto interned a dep's $(B)/ meta path only to feed mountVFS; resolving the path straight from the string means execution goroutines never write the global intern map while the generator goroutine is still interning.
notes: Motive was a crash ('fatal error: concurrent map read and map write'), not speed; it preserves the lock-free single-writer intern-table invariant the gen relies on.

lever: hoist literal Intern/Source/Build/internString calls into package vars
site: `ay refac consts` AST tool (refac.go); applied to 16 files (gen.go, sources.go, emit_*) + internString literals in 3 files
mechanism: Constant path literals passed to Intern/Source/Build/internString inside function bodies are deduplicated into package-level vars, so each is interned once at package init instead of hashed and probed on every call.
notes: Commit bodies state no perf motive or numbers (framed as refactoring); later explicitly perf-motivated hoists (529c783, 64815e6, 49e0f7b, 857170e) apply the same idea. Literals only inside file-level composite literals are left inline; internString gets its own str-prefixed namespace.

notes: ENV 0 reserved as 'not interned'; ENV table single-writer like internTable.

notes: Behaviour identical; preparatory for 8296b72.

lever: hoist dirKey("") to a srcRootVFS constant
site: fs IsFile(dirKey(""), rel) at 12 sites (parser_manager fileExistsByRel, emit_proto, emit_pr, swig/flatc/en/py_run/modules/make/mine/sysincl)
mechanism: The constant source root '$(S)/' was re-interned on every root-relative existence probe; a package var Source("") interns it once.

site: buildIfEnv; strSSE41CFlags etc.; Platform.ClangVerSTR / BuildTypeUpperSTR; strCPPProto

site: node_attrs KV ProcKind/PColor; procKindStr[k] array; attribute_generated dispatch
mechanism: 29 process kinds and 7 colours stored as 1-byte enums instead of 16-byte string headers; integer compares/switches; strings produced by direct array index only at JSON emit, hash and executor display.

site: Cmd.CmdArgs; ANY (uint32: low 3 bits tag ENV/TOK/ARG/STR/VFS); sinks canon/gjson_write/executor
mechanism: Command args hold interned ids with cheap boxing and are materialized to strings only at sinks (uid canon, JSON writer, executor).

lever: static internArgs([]string{...}) flag bundles become []ARG vectors of pre-interned consts
mechanism: Static flag bundles become []ARG{argA, ...} of consts, so no runtime internArgs over a string slice at init.

lever: hoist constant intern-literal calls into pre-interned package-level consts (ay refac consts)

notes: Duplicate-value vars keep distinct names (e888d69). The internAny lint and any_consts.go were dropped when ANY was removed (7663858).

lever: Cmd.Cwd as STR and Node.Platform as *Platform; drop dead per-node platform string writes
mechanism: Working-dir token interned once and rendered at the sink; node literals no longer set a platform string that bindNodePlatform immediately overwrote (41 sites); the graph writer/UID render the target via platformTarget(p), a free cast of the PlatformID built once in NewPlatform.
notes: bindNodePlatform itself later removed (0689fb7).

lever: back ARG/ENV intern tables by the STR table; uniform free str() conversions
mechanism: The STR intern table becomes the single string store; ARG/ENV drop their own []string + map[string], and ARG->STR / ENV->STR are O(1) array loads, enabling heterogeneous tokens to be boxed as plain STR.
notes: Precondition for replacing ANY with STR (7663858).

lever: platform/node tag lists as []STR
mechanism: Tags are interned once at NewPlatform; host-tag check compares an interned id; writer/UID render via appendStrSlice/writeStrSlice so tags hash by their .los.

lever: CmdArgs as plain []STR; ANY tagged union removed
mechanism: Every interned token converts to its backing STR for free, so command args are a flat []STR and boxing call sites use .str() instead of tagged-union helpers; 185 anyX aliases inlined.
notes: Supersedes b550806. CmdArgs later chunked into argChunks [][]STR (1dc57a0).

lever: EnvVars typed (ENV, STR); DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH interned once per platform
site: EnvVar{Name ENV; Value STR}; uid writeEnv; Platform.MultiarchLibPathSTR; m4Tool
mechanism: Env bindings are interned at construction; uid hashes them via writeSTR (.los) instead of writeBytes on name and value; JSON/executor materialize via a slice lookup; the DYLD value is interned once in NewPlatform instead of rebuilt and carried per ToolEnv() call.
notes: 19f7b2b later precomputes the whole ToolEnvVars per platform.

lever: STR.vfs(): convert a rooted STR to VFS by shift + root bit, no re-interning
site: STR.vfs(); sc.resolve rooted targets; INDUCED_DEPS handler
mechanism: VFS is STR<<1|root over the same table slot, so a STR holding a full rooted path converts to its VFS without a table probe (0 when not rooted); rooted INDUCED_DEPS targets bind directly ahead of the include search.
effect: intern strs 200431 -> 200404 (the rel spellings of rooted induced deps are no longer interned).
notes: Also a parity fix (98 CC nodes regained protoc wire_format.h).

lever: single-pass upstream argument expansion stops interning intermediate partial expansions
mechanism: Args without '$' pass through verbatim; ${NAME} refs resolve left-to-right in one pass (unresolved stay literal), replacing multi-pass partial expansion that interned intermediates.
effect: sg5 intern strs 204222 -> 200431 (-3791): the multi-pass partial expansions no longer intern intermediates; envs +1 (ARCADIA_ROOT).
notes: Modelling commit (ymake TEvalContext::Deref semantics); the intern-table shrink is incidental.

lever: ModuleInstance.Path string -> VFS
mechanism: Module dir is Source-rooted: bare Source(instance.Path) sites become the field itself; string contexts read .Rel().
effect: Intern table grows by 55 strs (204175 -> 204230); args/envs/overflow and all other perf counters unchanged.

lever: Platform.SystemLibs/LinkPreludeExtra interned once as []STR
mechanism: Constant string slices were re-interned on every link node via appendInternStrs; they are interned once at Platform construction and appended directly.

lever: GeneratedFileInfo.ProducerKvP string -> ProcKind enum
mechanism: Producer kinds pass pk* constants; the antlr CF check becomes an integer compare.

lever: node attribute strings retyped to bool / uint8 enums
mechanism: Fields that only ever held a few literals become bool/uint8 enums (zero = absent), stringified only at JSON emit; uid encoding switches writeBytes -> writeBool/writeByte.

lever: key buildParsed by VFS
mechanism: Drops the .Rel() stringification on both register and lookup; VFS is an interned uint32, a free identity key.
notes: Every registered output verified Build()-rooted; fe3ac93 makes a source-rooted registration fail fast.

lever: pre-intern constant ragel flags; Platform.MarchArgs computed once
mechanism: EmitR6 re-interned the constant flags per .rl source and compileFlagBundleFor re-interned -march (plus a fresh slice) per compile node on aarch64; both are now hoisted (package-level vars, per-platform field).
effect: eager is safe: the sg5 intern counter stays at args=2042

lever: sysincl mappings keyed by STR with values pre-cooked to VFS at parse
site: SysIncl.Mappings map[STR][]VFS + MappingsCI; sysinclContribution.paths []VFS; absifyRels removed
mechanism: Keys are interned at parse; values are converted to Source() VFS once at parse with empty suppression entries dropped there, so the lookup path no longer absolutizes rels per lookup.
effect: Pre-cooking interns every mapping value including never-fired ones: sg5 intern strs 201975 -> 204175 (+2200); all other perf counters and all validate.py gating cases byte-identical.
notes: Staging maps later replaced by pair slices (767e3e7); lookup moved fully to id space (2260e28).

lever: TargetProperties.ModuleTag as pre-interned STR (0 = absent)
site: TargetProperties.ModuleTag and plumbing (EmitAR*Tagged, EmitEN/EV/PB, EmitCF, EmitLD, ModuleCCInputs.ModuleTag)
mechanism: 14 compile-time tag constants are pre-interned; string/*string params become STR with 0 as absent (replacing nil-pointer presence checks); uid encodes via writeSTR (xxh3 lo).
effect: sg5 intern growth: strs 201962 -> 201975 (+13; one of the 14 consts was already interned). args/envs/overflow and all other perf counters unchanged.

lever: sysincl merged-index lookup addressed purely by target id
site: sysincl merged index: flat bucket slice + byID IntValueMap; SysinclContribution.rawKeyID; lookup(path, target STR)
mechanism: ToLower for the bucket probe and a string compare for case-exactness are replaced by one IntValueMap probe from target id to bucket slot plus the bucket scan; case-variant targets are bound at ciClaims' first touch; CS exactness is id equality.
effect: 74,456 views on sg5, the table's #1

lever: ModuleData lives in STR space
site: ModuleData token-list fields ([]STR), STR-keyed maps (perSrcCFlags, flatSrcs, ...), ModuleCCInputs DefaultVars/SetVars, PySrcGroup, AntlrRunInfo
mechanism: Collect-layer outputs follow the parser into ids; emit-layer string work reads .string() views; membership probes use interned ids (strsContain probes without polluting the table).
effect: sg5 intern strs: 229,513 -> 229,522 (+9) — the collect layer was already interning these tokens downstream.

lever: codegen registry keyed off ids: bySplit by Source-dir VFS, byStr by STR; lookup-only intern probes
site: CodegenRegistry bySplit/byStr; lookupSplit, lookupSTR; internedPrefixed/internedBytes (lookup-only); lookupRel deleted
mechanism: The hot includer-dir split lookup holds the dir VFS already, so the per-call rel() view + interned() xxh3 probe disappear; cold sides use lookup-only twins that probe without inserting; registration interns '$(S)/'+prefix so bare-prefix strings vanish.
effect: the intern table nets smaller (229,522 -> 229,317 on sg5); the includer-dir quoted split lookup, ~137k/run
notes: Also collapses a duplicate probe of the same key on the firstClaim path.

lever: ya.make macro-argument parser emits []STR with an identity fast path in expansion
site: ~25 statement structs; expandStmtTokensSTR/expandStmtTokenSTR; strKeySet / kw* consts
mechanism: Every macro-call argument token is interned at collection, forcing downstream into id space: a token without '$' passes through as the same id with zero string work; keyword recognition compares interned ids; text needs use .string() views into the intern table (no allocation).
effect: sg5 intern strs: 209,085 -> 229,513 (+20,428) — the arg tokens that never reached the intern table before (IF args, RESOURCE keys, unhandled-macro args) now live there once instead of as transient strings per use.
notes: Intern-table growth traded for no transient strings per use.

lever: 0-sentinel for interned/lookup probes instead of (id, bool)
mechanism: The reserved 0 slot of each id space doubles as 'never interned/unknown/does not resolve', so probes return a single id; resolveSourceUnder's miss caches directly as VFS 0 in sourceUnderCache.
notes: Codebase-wide sweep for (STR|VFS|ENV|ARG, bool) returns.

lever: VFS root bit tested inline (drop VFS.root())
site: vfs.go VFS.isSource/isBuild; callers in parser_manager, scanner (x3 + addincl switch), emit_proto; test bucket helpers
mechanism: The source/build root lives in the low bit of the VFS uint32. The root() method (uint32(v)&1 -> VFSRoot, then compared with VFSRootSource/Build) was removed; isSource/isBuild are now bare bit tests (uint32(v)&1 == 0 / != 0) and every direct .root() comparison routes through them.
effect: sg5 CPU profile: VFS.root 0.12s/1.68% flat -> VFS.isBuild 0.05s/0.7% (isSource sub-threshold)
notes: VFSRootSource/VFSRootBuild constants kept for the VFS factories. Gate byte-exact sg2/sg2_x86_64/sg3/sg4/sg5.

lever: autoinclude index as IntValueMap[VFS] + lookup-only internedPrefixed ancestor probe
mechanism: Deepest-first ancestor walk of the module dir; each ancestor is probed with internedPrefixed("$(S)/", d), a lookup-only intern probe that returns 0 for a non-interned prefix, over substrings - allocation-free on the fast path; longest prefix wins.
effect: ancestor-walk ~86 ns/op (measured later in 6c08c29)
notes: Replaced the same day by the Darts double-array trie (7b33cf1): the probe hashed the full path at every ancestor.

lever: sourceInputVFS/copyFileInputVFS take the module-dir VFS
mechanism: The module path arrived as a string and was re-interned (source(modulePath), dirKey(modulePath)) every call; callers pass instance.Path, the string form comes from .rel() (substring, no alloc); prefix test by index compare instead of modulePath+"/"; moduleRel computed lazily via variadic source when clean has no '..'.
effect: sourceInputVFS hot lines 524(13645)+529(21009) eliminated; total alloc_objects 1903394 -> 1869160

lever: constant STR instead of per-node re-interned string
mechanism: SbomLang had two constant values carried as a string re-interned on every LD node; it becomes STR consts (unitSbomCpp/unitSbomPy3) flowing straight into the command.

lever: lookup-only probes built in the intern bump pool
mechanism: vfsPrefixScratch is dropped: lookup-only probes are built in the uncommitted tail of the intern byte pool, prefix+bytes interning commits on miss, and sourceBytes loses its double copy.

lever: flat intern cells for the generator + PageVec for shared readers
mechanism: Single-threaded generator reads str/lo with one indexed load from a flat array; executor goroutines read the PageVec whose pages never move.
effect: bs_static: PageVec cell reads 0.49s cum -> 0, total samples 28.2s -> 27.3s, wall at parity, max-rss +14MB (the duplicated cells)
notes: Duplicates every cell (+14MB). Appends to the shared PageVec later go through a tracked current page (bccb3a2).

lever: split intern str and lo into separate arrays
mechanism: Separate []string and []uint64 arrays instead of one []internCell{str, lo}.
effect: wall 4.62s vs 4.55s merged
notes: 60d1540: 'the lookup touches lo then str of one id, and separate arrays cost two cold cache lines'. Codex re-did the split in 3a3d4b6 (flatStr/flatLo, internLo/internString) without published numbers; flatLo still exists at HEAD.

lever: VFS = rel-STR<<1 | root bit
site: VFS layout, intern()/source()/build(), CodegenRegistry byVFS/byRel, VFS-keyed caches
mechanism: Only the rel part is interned; rel() is bit math, STR.source()/.build() mint VFS without re-interning, the full '$(S)/rel' form is rendered on demand; strID() becomes identity; registry keyed by rel STR alone (only $(B) outputs); parse/scanner/listdir caches typed by VFS.
notes: Index-sensitive spots fixed by hand (uid inputVal hashes rel-lo xor root bit, etc.). Id spaces sized by vfsBound().

lever: statement tokens carry ANY classified at expansion
site: expandStmtTokens/internAny, ModuleData token lists, section machines
mechanism: The token expander classifies each token once ($(S)/$(B) forms get the VFS tag with only the rel interned); downstream code works on ANY instead of re-interning renderings.

lever: Cmd env values ANY; toolchain paths VFS
site: EnvVar.Value, ModuleToolchain path fields, wrapper scripts, CUDA_ROOT/OBJCOPY_TOOL, ResourceDecl.Value
mechanism: Env values and toolchain/script paths become VFS built from rels (JSON via appendVFS cache, uid writes the tag, executor mounts via mountANY); full-form string twins dropped.
notes: Full-form interning remains only at the parse boundary and in glued composite args.

lever: flag lists carry ANY end-to-end; ARG scalar-only
mechanism: All []ARG flag lists store []ANY from parse onward, killing per-node/per-module ARG->ANY conversions (appendArgAny/argAnyList at 38 sites, ~10 platform-constant lists per LD/BI/BC node, PerSourceCFlags per CC node).
notes: DeDuper.add grows on demand since ANY-tagged keys can exceed the reset-time bound.

lever: rekey root-invariant stores by rel STR
site: FS interface keys, dirs DenseMap, DirView.dir, contentHashes, SharedParseCache.parsed, resolveSourceUnder key, ScriptDeps
mechanism: Stores that only ever see source paths (root bit irrelevant) key by rel STR; conversion at call sites is free bit math and the addressed id space halves.

lever: store env values as VFS; render lazily (envVFS)
site: Environment (CURDIR/BINDIR), yasm in/out args, archive file args
mechanism: A runtime probe at internAppend showed CURDIR/BINDIR dominated full-form interns (8.9k per-module interns read only when ya.make references them); Environment gains an envVFS kind rendered on read; yasm/archive args become VFS-tagged ANYs.
effect: 8.9k per-module interns for values read only when a ya.make references them
notes: Measurement: caller-location probe at internAppend for every new full-form entry.

lever: direct current-page append for the shared intern PageVec
mechanism: The shared-reader PageVec is appended through a tracked current page instead of PageVec.set per append (page computation + atomic load each time).

lever: lexer tokens carry STR ids
mechanism: Tokens store the interned id instead of a string; macro args append tok.id.any() with no re-intern, keywords compare by id (kwIF/kwELSE/...).

lever: EN cross-EN dep detection via scanner parse cache instead of re-reading files
mechanism: The loop did an os.Open + bufio.NewScanner per closure entry to find _serialized.h includes; it now asks the scanner, which already parsed every closure file during the WalkClosure that produced the closure, so each lookup is a cache hit.
effect: M3 wall time -> 4.47s (under 5s gate)
notes: Also removes ~30 LOC of ad-hoc bracket extraction.

lever: FS.Walk on cached Listdir + shared proto/ev import scanning
site: fs.go FS.Walk; swigLibInputs, applyAllPySrcs; cfIncludeDirectives/buildCFGVars; proto/.ev import scanning (parseProtoImports)
mechanism: Recursive directory walks (swig Lib enumeration, ALL_PY_SRCS) use a DFS over the cached Listdir, so they share the run-wide directory cache instead of filepath.WalkDir; proto/.ev import scanning goes through one shared helper over FS instead of open/close per file.

lever: FS abstraction with run-wide cached directory listings (smart Exists)
site: fs.go FS.Exists/Listdir/IsFile/IsDir/ReadAbs; parser_manager exists map, sysincl YAML loader, sources.go/emit_cc/emit_as_helpers/emit_sources/defaults/modules stat checks, ya.make parser INCLUDE expansion
mechanism: Exists(rel) routes through a cached Listdir(dirname): N per-file os.Stat calls over the same directory collapse into 1 ReadDir + N map lookups. Caches never invalidate (sources immutable during a Gen run); one FS per run held on genCtx.fs and shared by parser manager, sysincl loader, source resolution and every ya.make/INCLUDE read.

mechanism: Open+Stat+Read+Read(EOF)+Close = 5 syscalls/file; sources are immutable during a run, so read exactly sz bytes and return (grow-to-EOF loop kept as fallback when Stat fails).

mechanism: The copy's source VFS is looked up by dst from CodegenRegistry.SourcePath instead of being re-derived from entry.Src via copyFileInputVFS, which did a filesystem existence probe per entry.
effect: No graph change: sg5 matched self_uid stays 26110
notes: withContextSourceExtras was later collapsed by 128f8dd (TEXT-copy source rides as a closure leaf).

mechanism: f.Stat() allocated an *os.fileStat per file read just to pre-size the buffer; syscall.Fstat into a stack-resident Stat_t (&st does not escape) is zero-alloc and keeps the exact pre-size.
effect: ~10MB churn over an sg5 run removed
notes: Linux target.

lever: cache file sizes in Listdir
mechanism: Considered caching sizes from directory listing to avoid the per-read stat.

mechanism: The hand-rolled first-level gating (Listdir(prefix)) followed by fileExistsByRel(joinRel(prefix, target)) re-listed from the source root and re-gated the prefix's components; IsFile keyed off the already-interned prefix VFS does it once.
effect: drops the redundant Listdir(srcRoot) and duplicated first-level walk per multi-component resolve (~33k/run)

lever: Listdir via File.ReadDir(-1) (unsorted) + pointerless set
mechanism: Proposed to avoid os.ReadDir's sort of ~370k names and the GC scan of map[string]bool string keys. Measured: the sort is negligible and the GC part vanished with GC off for -j 0.

notes: PERF.md item 12-A, kept as cleanup. f61a9b6 later caches the miss as VFS 0 directly.

effect: 279,049 views on sg5 (#1 in the --probe=str table) over only 29,596 unique target ids (~9x repeat). ... sg5: 35,921 views remain (one per unique target per scanner), total .string() 918,666 -> 648,953.
notes: Pattern reused for strHasDollar (fcd2014) and srcExtClassOf (d5cde3d).

site: SRCS .h.in/.y routing, collectModule .ev/.proto/.fbs pass, genModule isCodegenProducingSrc gates, appendCC markers
mechanism: Four sites ran suffix triage over the same src ids; the class is a pure function of the id, so the first touch pays one view and every other site switches on the cached class.
effect: ~90k views on sg5
notes: appendCC no longer needs the string at all.

lever: strHasDollar: first-touch TwoBitSet memo of the '$' predicate per STR
mechanism: Tokens repeat heavily and an interned string is immutable, so Contains('$') is constant per id; repeats answer from a 2-bit probe and only the first touch views the string.
effect: 56k views on sg5, #3 in the --probe=str table
notes: Same pattern as ciMemo (999ba98); reused as the ${-check gate in SRCS/PEERDIR (d5cde3d).

lever: sealed ScanContext: config hash computed once at construction; ScanContext carries its resolved *ScanConfig

mechanism: newScanContext seals the config hash once (seeded non-zero) and binds the *ScanConfig (dense id + resolve index) deduped by content hash on first sight, so newScanCtx does no table lookups and no per-walk hash mix; variant sites (asm, cython, JOIN_SRCS per-arch rebase) reseal. The config id space is global on the shared parser manager, so host/target dedupe the same content.
effect: the per-walk configByHash probe (24.8k/run) and the scanner-side config table are gone
notes: Supersedes configByHash merge (ea1230a) and the reverted memo (a8bc60a).

mechanism: The first walk in a module resolves the config and later walks reuse the ScanCtx (keyed by scanner, root parser); mutating copies drop the memo. hashScanContext got a non-zero seed so the empty context cannot hit IntMap's reserved 0 key.
effect: (~24.8k/run — the map-op runner-up, plus the ScanCtx allocation and the hashScanContext mix over every addincl slice)

lever: register-then-walk two-phase codegen emission (scan-cache correctness invariant)
